product_thesis.user_job: Prioritize lawful China Prophet candidates entering mechanism-coherent, accessible rerating sequences before broad recognition.
product_thesis.machine_job: Maintain point-in-time anatomy, exact event/adverse/access outcomes, immutable predictions/corrections, and fixed-candidate counterfactual ordering.
product_thesis.canonical_formula: carrier × mechanism evidence × transition/release × sector/catalyst authorization × Prophet actionability × access
product_thesis.moat: Correction-safe chronology and cross-plane sequence, not indicator count.

P0 main-board risk-warning rows from 2026-07-06 quarantined

missing is not zero; event date is not known-at

architecture_decisions.answer: CN-Limit is a mechanism-aware event-hazard and accessible-rerating system, not a one-score technical indicator.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Different corporate, policy, ownership, reflexive, and supply mechanisms can produce the same limit-up endpoint but have different lawful clocks, precursors, confounders, access, and continuation.

architecture_decisions.answer: Structural washout is a carrier/baseline, not the new selector.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Prophet already concentrates in washed-out/coiled names and P-B2/P-B3 did not certify static-state timing/occupancy.

architecture_decisions.answer: Ordered mechanism sequence is the primary conjunction object; unordered confirmation count is a negative control.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Correlated technicals manufacture confidence. Professional discovery, transition, sector authorization, Prophet actionability, and retail recognition have directional time order.

architecture_decisions.answer: Tape features describe downside ineffectiveness, resilience, reclaim quality, and constructive-volume asymmetry; they never label hidden accumulation, insider activity, manipulation, or orchestration.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Intent is latent and cannot be inferred from OHLCV. Actor claims require independent public evidence.

architecture_decisions.answer: First exact board, continuous rerating, adverse breakdown, access, continuation, and capacity are separate outcomes.
architecture_decisions.rationale: A model can predict locked boards yet be commercially useless; board probability and achievable expectancy are not interchangeable.

architecture_decisions.answer: Authority-grade first-board outcomes require unadjusted nominal prices, vendor exact legal limits, positive-volume eligibility, and integer-cent equality.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Adjusted prices, reconstructed ratios, tolerant primary labels, and ties-to-even rounding caused the binding stop-ship.

architecture_decisions.answer: Use the existing candidate plane, board/path grader, identity, event, and nightly planes; CN-Limit adds only derived anatomy plus a referential immutable research sidecar.
architecture_decisions.rationale: A duplicate candidate plane or grader would create diverging truth and destroy attribution.

architecture_decisions.answer: I1 prospective measurement shadow must precede I2 ordering shadow.
architecture_decisions.rationale: A feature must survive exact outcomes, Prophet overlap, valid nulls, calibration, access, and prospective proof before an order counterfactual is meaningful.

architecture_decisions.answer: A challenger order exists only when every member of the frozen comparison population has a valid prediction under one definition.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Per-row incumbent fallback mixed with challenger values creates incomparable scales and selection bias.

architecture_decisions.answer: Champion era is keyed by board definition plus effective order basis, order mode, score/admission hashes, and candidate schema—not board_definition alone.
architecture_decisions.rationale: A v4 bake served through v3 fallback is not the same treatment as a complete Intelligence-ordered v4 bake.

architecture_decisions.answer: One preregistered challenger enters each prospective race; any formula/model/threshold change starts a new era.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Selecting the best of many observed challengers invalidates the forward comparison.

architecture_decisions.answer: Research, prediction, ordering, score, gate, size, and public probability are separate authority grants.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Success at one level does not establish safety or value at the next.

architecture_decisions.answer: The new Prophet Operator Lab is an adjacent US/Radar read-only product, not a CN-Limit owner or storage seam.
architecture_decisions.rationale: It is fixture-based, not live-wired, and has its own detector ontology. Automatic reuse would blur programs and create a shortcut around canonical China planes.

active_features.name: Downside price-impact decay relative to upside impact

definition.window_logic: W1=d-19..d; W0=d-39..d-20. Calculate impact separately on negative and positive sessions.
definition.interpretation: Positive means downside impact fell more than upside/general price impact. It is actor-neutral and must never be labeled hidden accumulation.
definition.minimum_support: At least five valid negative and five valid positive sessions across each comparison window; otherwise NOT_COVERED.

required_inputs.basis: Raw nominal OHLCV through decision session d; no bar after d.
required_inputs.market_excess_t: r_t - beta_{t-1} * r_market,t, with beta estimated only from trailing observations

active_features.name: Completed reclaim speed, hold quality, adverse excursion, and failure history

definition.setup: A reclaim episode begins after at least five consecutive closes below the lagged 20-session moving average.
definition.reclaim: First close back above the lagged MA20; the MA value is frozen at the reclaim session for episode evaluation.
definition.speed: Sessions from the episode's lowest close to the reclaim close.
definition.hold: Among the next five completed sessions available by d, count closes at or above the frozen reclaim level.
definition.mae: Minimum low relative to the frozen reclaim level over the completed hold window.

states.PENDING_RECLAIM: reclaim occurred but the five-session hold window has not completed
states.FAILED: two or more closes below the level or mae<=-0.02
states.MIXED_HISTORY: multiple completed episodes with conflicting states

definition.primary_output: latest completed state plus component vector; no hidden scalar score.
